blurb:
AN INDOOR ADVENTURE!! Chase around Calgary’s indoor +15 system rounding up a menagerie of escaped animals! There is a trail of clues for the animals to be found, but someone needs to solve them and save the day. Do YOU have what it takes?

**GAME DOES NOT OPERATE SUNDAYS AND HOLIDAYS**

All Cluesolvers Adventures are designed to be played in teams of 2 - 5 people and are priced per group. You and your team work together to solve a series of clues & puzzles hidden around town using Cluesolvers App on your phone. The Adventure will guide you around your destination to local icons as well as the hidden gems that even the locals might not know about! 

Unless indicated above, you may start your adventure on any day at any time (playing in daylight is recommended). There is no time limit to finish - race the leaderboard, or just slow down and enjoy - either way you can take advantage of the built-in breaks where the clock stops so you can enjoy where you are!
